svg.title: Ahmed Wesam | Engineering profile
svg.desc: Ahmed Wesam. Computer Science at Nile University, Sheikh Zayed, Cairo, Egypt. Backend architecture, modern client interfaces, and private infrastructure. Backend: .NET Core, C# 12, Clean Architecture, Enterprise APIs. Frontend: React, Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript. Hosting: Docker, VPS Deployments, Local Server Nodes, Linux, Railway. Storage: Cloudflare R2, S3 Object Storage, Supabase PostgreSQL, MongoDB. Coding with AI agents: Codex, Claude, Gemini. Problem solving: ECPC Finalist, 73rd in Egypt. Initiatives: Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors, Head of SWE Track; Google Developer Groups on Campus, Backend Mentor; Samsung Innovation Campus, IoT Alumnus; Nile University Student Union, Head of the Technical Committee. Guides on github.com/AGhaith: GitHub-Guide, VS-Code-Guide, Google-Development-Group, educational-projects. Email: a.wesam2300@nu.edu.eg. LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/ahmed-wesam. The original silver and slate emblem floats beside the introduction.

g.text: Workshop materials, development workflows, and academic work.
